title: Лучшая теннисистка России - Анна Калинская! Рейтинг "Чемпионата": третий квартал 2025 года
content: The "Championat" ranking for the third quarter of 2025 declares Anna Kalinskaya the best Russian tennis player, earning 31 points from a 10‑win, 4‑loss record and a 29th‑ranked world position (rating 28 on 9 June 2025).  Kalinskaya’s points came from a 10‑point bonus for being in the WTA top 10, 1 point for a win over a top‑50 player (Radu Kan), 6 points for two wins over top‑30 players (Linett, Merten), 8 points for two wins over top‑20 players (Tausson, Alexandrovna), 5 points for a win over a top‑10 player (Anisimova), and 3 points for reaching the final of a WTA‑500 event in Washington and the quarter‑final of a WTA‑1000 event in Cincinnati.  The ranking system awards 10 points for a top‑10 WTA spot, 9 for top‑20, etc., and additional bonus points for tournament progress and victories over higher‑ranked opponents.  Other top performers include Mirra Andreeva (20 points, 5th‑ranked, 5‑4 record), Elena Pavlyuchenkova (16 points, 45th‑ranked, 7‑5 record), Veronika Kudermetova (15 points, 25th‑ranked, 10‑5 record), and Lyudmila Samsonova (14 points, 20th‑ranked, 9‑6 record).  The article lists the full point‑scoring rules and the final table of players, noting that the top three for the quarter are Andreeva, Alexandrovna, and Samsonova, with Kalinskaya close behind.  No direct quotes appear in the article, and the reporting is purely descriptive of the ranking methodology and results.

title: 亚历山德洛娃生涯首次跻身世界前十之列，本赛季三进500赛决赛
content: According to the WTA official rankings released on October 13, 2025, Aleksandra Assenova has reached a career-high ranking of world No. 10, marking her first time entering the top 10 in her career. She advanced one spot in the rankings, driven by strong performances this season, including reaching three WTA 500 finals—winning in Linz and finishing as runner-up in Monterrey and Seoul. She also advanced to the second week of three Grand Slam tournaments and achieved over 40 WTA match wins in a single season for the first time. Assenova became the third player this season to debut in the top 10, following Mirra Andreeva and Anna Kalinskaya.

title: Александрова впервые в карьере поднимется в первую десятку рейтинга WTA
content: Russian tennis player Ekaterina Alexandrova will rise to the top 10 of the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) rankings for the first time in her career following her performance at the Wuhan Open in China. She reached the quarterfinals of the tournament, losing to American Jessica Pegula, and will rank 10th in the updated WTA rankings. Currently ranked 11th, this marks her highest career ranking. The top spot in the rankings is held by Belarusian player Aryna Sabalenka. Alexandrova, who is 30 years old, has won five WTA singles titles throughout her career. Meanwhile, fellow Russian player Mirra Andreeva is expected to drop out of the top five after the Wuhan tournament concludes.

title: Костюк проводит 250-ю неделю в топ-100 рейтинга WTA. Сколько у Свитолиной?
content: Ukrainian tennis player Marta Kostyuk has spent her 250th week in the top 100 of the WTA rankings. Kostyuk first entered the top 100 on November 9, 2020, and has remained there ever since. This achievement makes her the seventh Ukrainian tennis player to reach this milestone. Elina Svitolina holds the record for the most weeks spent in the top 100, with 594 weeks. Kostyuk's highest ranking in the WTA is 16th, which she achieved on July 17, 2024.

title: Александрова обновила личный рекорд, поднявшись на 14-е место в рейтинге WTA
content: Russian tennis player Ekaterina Alexandrova has moved up to 14th place in the WTA rankings, earning 2,786 points. This is a personal record for Alexandrova, surpassing her previous record of 15th place. Belarusian Arina Sabalenka remains the world's number one tennis player, with 11,225 points. Iga Swiatek from Poland has returned to second place, with 7,933 points, surpassing Coco Gauff from the US, who has 7,874 points. Mirella Andreeva remains the top-ranked Russian player, at 5th place with 4,733 points.

title: Российская теннисистка Александрова впервые вошла в топ-10 рейтинга WTA
content: Russian tennis player Ekaterina Alexandrova has reached a career-high ranking of 10th in the WTA rankings, becoming the first in her career to enter the top 10. She previously held the 11th position. Her recent performance at the WTA 1000 tournament in Wuhan, where she reached the third round before losing to Jessica Pegula, contributed to her rise. Pegula moved up to 5th in the rankings, surpassing Mirra Andreeva, who now holds the 6th position. However, Andreeva remains Russia’s top-ranked player. The top three in the WTA rankings are Belarusian Aryna Sabalenka (10,400 points), Polish Iga Świątek (8,768), and American Coco Gauff (7,873). Among Russian players in the top 100, notable rankings include Lyudmila Samsonova (18th), Diana Shnaider (19th), Veronika Kudermetova (31st), Anna Kalinskaya (37th), Anastasia Pavlyuchenkova (50th), Anastasia Potapova (53rd), Anna Blinkova (73rd), Polina Kudermetova (75th), and Anastasiya Zakharchenko (80th). Alexandrova has five WTA titles and her best Grand Slam results include reaching the fourth round at Wimbledon, Roland Garros, and the US Open. In 2021, she helped the Russian team win the Billie Jean King Cup. Meanwhile, Russian player Daniil Medvedev lost to France’s Arthur Rinderknech (ranked 54th) in the Shanghai Masters quarterfinals, with the match lasting 2 hours and 29 minutes and ending 6–4, 2–6, 4–6. Rinderknech reached the Masters semifinals for the first time.

title: Кудерметова поднялась на десять позиций в рейтинге WTA
content: Kudermetova has risen ten positions in the WTA rankings and now holds the 26th place with 1763 points. She remains the second-best Russian player, behind Mira Andreeva who is in fifth place with 4733 points. Other Russian players in the top 20 include Ekaterina Alexandrova (2786 points) and Ludmila Samsonova (2166 points). Diana Schneider has dropped out of the top 20 and now holds the 22nd position with 2036 points. Belarusian Arina Sabalenka leads the rankings with 11225 points.

title: Даяна Ястремская провела 200 недель в топ-50 WTA: кто из украинок был там дольше
content: Diana Yastremskaya has spent 200 weeks in the WTA top‑50, the most recent update placing her at 32nd overall. She first entered the top‑50 on 28 January 2019 and has left the list twice, but each time returned. Her career best ranking was 21st, achieved on 20 January 2020. Only three Ukrainian players have comparable longevity in the top‑50: Elina Svitolina leads with the most weeks, Lesya Tsurenko follows with 233 weeks, and Alena Bondarenko is third. If Yastremskaya remains in the top‑50 for another eight months, she could reach second place among Ukrainian players in terms of total weeks in the top‑50 by May 2026.

title: Теннисистка Александрова впервые в карьере войдет в топ-10 рейтинга WTA
content: Russian tennis player Ekaterina Alexandrova will enter the top 10 of the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) rankings for the first time in her career, effective Monday, October 9, 2025. This milestone follows her participation in the WTA 1000 tournament in Wuhan, China, where she was eliminated in the second round by American Jessica Pegula. At 30 years old, Alexandrova currently holds the 11th position in the WTA rankings, marking her career-best ranking. The world No. 1 ranking is held by Aryna Sabalenka of Belarus.

title: Костюк стала сьомою українською тенісисткою, яка 250 тижнів знаходиться у топ-100 світового рейтингу - Марта серед топів
content: Marta Kostyuk has achieved a Grand Slam level of game stability, reaching 250 weeks in the top 100 of the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) ranking. According to the Great Tennis of Ukraine, Kostyuk became the seventh Ukrainian tennis player to achieve this milestone. The other six players who have achieved this feat are Elina Svitolina, Lesya Tsurenko, Kateryna and Alona Bondarenko, Natalia Medvedeva, and Dayana Yastremskaya. Kostyuk debuted in the top 100 on November 9, 2020, and has not left the top 100 since. Her highest ranking was 16th place on June 17, 2024.
